program.title: CARL WEATHERS BUILD
program.subtitle: 13-Week Strength + Size — Sandbag, KB, Rings
program.notes: Eating to grow: bodyweight should trend up slowly. Three waves of 3 build weeks plus a lighter week, then test (week 12) and deload (week 13). Schedule: keep a rest day between Sandbag Lower and Pull (e.g. Mon Push, Tue Sandbag, Thu Pull, Sat Legs). Sandbag: add 10lbs only when every rep is a clean pickup with no rounding; carries progress distance first, then load. Pull-ups restart at bodyweight with a neutral grip on free-rotating rings, and reps only go up when the elbows and shoulders allow. Pain rule: up to 3/10 that is gone by the next morning is OK. Anything more: band-assisted pull-ups, or KB pullovers if those hurt too. Elbow or shoulder pain that lasts more than 2 weeks is worth a physio visit. 24+20 means a mixed pair: switch which hand holds the 24 each set. If you buy a second 24, use 24+24. If top sets stall two weeks in a row, cut accessory sets first.

1.goal: On-ramp. Leave reps in the tank. Pull-ups restart at 3 slow reps; see how elbows and shoulders respond before adding anything.

blocks.note: Shoulders stop just below elbows at the bottom; turn the rings out at the top. If the front of the shoulder complains, cut depth first. Drop to +5lbs if it keeps talking. If dips hurt at any load, do KB Floor Press 10@24+20 instead.
Clean every rep.

The 350 (TREE FITTY): about 70 reps a round, building to 5 rounds (350 reps) in wave 3. Loads stay at 16 all block; progress with a 3s lowering, not weight. Pullover: lie on the floor, knees bent, bell by the horns, ribs down, lower behind your head on a 3-count, pull back with the lats. Lateral raise replaces the upright row. If an elbow goes above 3/10, swap the crush curl for KB Bottoms-Up Hold :20'@16.

Main lift. Alternate weeks of triples and fives. Add 10lbs only when every rep is a clean pickup with no rounding to rescue it. Drop to 120lbs if a rep rounds. Push-ups go in the rest: easy chest volume that doesn't touch the legs or back.
Zercher: size lift for quads and upper back. Bag in the crooks of your elbows, stay tall. Wear sleeves or a towel; if the elbows complain, do SB Bear Hug Squat 8 at the same load instead.
Heavy carries. Distance first (40, 50, 60 steps), then the next wave resets to 40 at +10lbs. Switch shoulders each round.

Neutral grip, rings free to rotate. 3 seconds down on every rep. Add the next rep only if last session stayed at 3/10 or less and the next morning was fine. Pain rule: up to 3/10 in the elbow or shoulder is OK if it is no worse the next morning. Above that: finish the sets as band-assisted pull-ups (@-20lbs); if those hurt too, do KB Pullover 12@16 instead.
Supported row: one hand braced on a box or bench so the lower back rests before leg day. Pause 1s at the top. Floor press keeps chest volume up. 24+20: switch hands each set.
Capped at these reps all block to keep elbow load in check. Squeeze 1s at the top.
Rear delts, side delts, triceps: the shoulder caps and arm size.
Load stays at 130lbs; progress time. Hug it high and tight, upper back working hard.
Explosive. Primes the hips; not a conditioning set.

Leg complex ladder: one pass of 10-8-6-4. Each rung: dead clean, front squat, box squat (sit fully, pause 1s, stand), thruster, reverse lunge from the rack (half the reps each leg). Bells touch the floor only before the dead cleans. Line up 16+16, 20+20 and 24+20 before you start and swap pairs in up to 60s between rungs. If thrusters break down, park the bells for 15s and finish. 24+20: switch hands each rung.
Split squats are the quad size work; core rides in the rest.
RTO = rings turned out at lockout. Chest and arm size work: 1-2 reps short of failure. Overhead extension: elbows in, slow down.
Carry medley with the lighter bag. Smooth distance, not max load.

Pullover: lie on the floor, knees bent, bell by the horns, ribs down, lower behind your head on a 3-count, pull back with the lats. Lateral raise replaces the upright row. If an elbow goes above 3/10, swap the crush curl for KB Bottoms-Up Hold :20'@16.
Power primer while fresh. Fast and crisp, not a grind.

Main lift. Alternate weeks of triples and fives. Add 10lbs only when every rep is a clean pickup with no rounding to rescue it. Drop to 140lbs if a rep rounds. Push-ups go in the rest: easy chest volume that doesn't touch the legs or back.
Zercher: size lift for quads and upper back. Bag in the crooks of your elbows, stay tall. Wear sleeves or a towel; if the elbows complain, do SB Bear Hug Squat 8 at the same load instead.
Heavy carries. Distance first (40, 50, 60 steps), then the next wave resets to 40 at +10lbs. Switch shoulders each round.

Neutral grip, rings free to rotate. Add the next rep only if last session stayed at 3/10 or less and the next morning was fine. Pain rule: up to 3/10 in the elbow or shoulder is OK if it is no worse the next morning. Above that: finish the sets as band-assisted pull-ups (@-20lbs); if those hurt too, do KB Pullover 12@16 instead.
Supported row: one hand braced on a box or bench so the lower back rests before leg day. Pause 1s at the top. Floor press keeps chest volume up. 24+20: switch hands each set.
Capped at these reps all block to keep elbow load in check. Squeeze 1s at the top.
Rear delts, side delts, triceps: the shoulder caps and arm size.
Load stays at 130lbs; progress time. Hug it high and tight, upper back working hard.
Second, easy pull-up exposure while fresh: neutral grip, well short of failure. Skip the pull-ups if Pull day broke the pain rule this week.

Leg complex ladder: one pass of 10-8-6-4. Each rung: dead clean, front squat, box squat (sit fully, pause 1s, stand), thruster, reverse lunge from the rack (half the reps each leg). Bells touch the floor only before the dead cleans. Line up 16+16, 20+20 and 24+20 before you start and swap pairs in up to 60s between rungs. If thrusters break down, park the bells for 15s and finish. 24+20: switch hands each rung.
Split squats are the quad size work; core rides in the rest.
RTO = rings turned out at lockout. Chest and arm size work: 1-2 reps short of failure. Overhead extension: elbows in, slow down.
Carry medley with the lighter bag. Smooth distance, not max load.
